response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior generalist with a strong web/full-stack background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) but lacks nearly all of the role's hard requirements. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese (languages listed are English, Romanian, German-basic), no embedded LAN-switch or network firmware experience, no Linux kernel source analysis/modification, and no exposure to the required security stack (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal) or L2/L3 networking, NETCONF, SNMP, or chip-vendor SDKs. C experience is limited to a brief 2014-2015 stint at National Instruments and a university project, over a decade ago. The Japanese-language requirement alone is a hard disqualifier.
strengths: 15+ years of professional software development experience, well above the 3-year minimum
Some prior C/C++ work (LabWindows/CVI at National Instruments) and Linux familiarity
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, and open-source project ownership
concerns: No evidence of Japanese language ability, a hard requirement
No embedded networking, switch firmware, or Linux kernel modification experience
No demonstrated security-domain knowledge (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption, tamper detection)

key_factors.factor: Depth of general software engineering experience
